primitives.name: Value Comprehension Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Why It Matters Users need to find value in 10 seconds.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_v': 'time in seconds for value discovery', 'V_u': 'user value signal (dimensionless)', 'M_p': 'media path type (categorical)'}
primitives.assumptions: User engagement decays exponentially with T_v > 10s; V_u is bounded by trust-safe media fidelity.

layer2.mapping: GSI's Bayesian belief update on V_u aligns with GSE's deterministic state transition on M_p.
layer2.telemetry: Time-to-value histogram and media-path success rate

primitives.name: Trust-Safe Media Path
primitives.verbatim_quote: GSE is proprietary and complex, so every major item needs an immediate explanation, a next action, and a trust-safe media or visual path.
primitives.assumptions: Each item requires E_i ∈ [0,1], A_n ∈ {0,1}, and M_s ≥ 0.8 for trust compliance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: M_s < 0.8 implies failure in user retention

layer2.mapping: GSE's action-state transition depends on M_s, while GSI evaluates E_i as evidence for belief update.
layer2.telemetry: Media path adherence rate and user retention post-action

primitives.name: Help Asset Pipeline
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Internal Value Galaxy Studios, support, product, and growth teams get a repeatable help asset pipeline instead of one-off explanations.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_a': 'pipeline asset count (integer)', 'R_r': 'repeatability rate (0 to 1)', 'C_c': 'cost per asset (currency)'}
primitives.assumptions: P_a increases with R_r; C_c is minimized when R_r > 0.9.
primitives.breakdown_regime: R_r < 0.9 implies increasing C_c and decreasing P_a

layer2.mapping: GSI's asset reuse probability aligns with GSE's pipeline state transitions.
layer2.telemetry: Asset reuse frequency and pipeline efficiency metrics
